description: List the connectors you added to Besidka (remote MCP servers its chats can use), most recently changed first, with id, title, host, status, whether it is switched on, how many of its tools are on and whether its tools changed since you reviewed them. Never returns addresses beyond the host, keys or tokens. Use nextCursor to get the next page. Requires signing in (connectors:read).
